definition: Sends each chosen gate message twice through the first Fast Chat call, built as in live_model: once with the SOURCE CHECK rule on (source_need_check=True, as with FAST_CHAT_NEEDS_SOURCES_ENABLED on) and once with it off (source_need_check=False, as production sends every turn with the setting off). Each arm is scored as live_model. Each message costs two model calls; --max-live-calls counts calls, so floor(limit / 2) messages are sent, evenly spaced. The run stops after the first auth or access error in either arm.
